directions: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on how students can make the best use of on-campus resources for academic development. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
In today's competitive academic environment, on-campus resources play a pivotal role in students' academic development. To make the best use of these resources, several strategies can be adopted.

To begin with, students should make full use of the library. It is a treasure trove of knowledge, housing a vast collection of books, journals, and online databases. For example, by accessing academic databases, students can conduct in-depth research for their papers. In addition, students can take advantage of academic workshops and seminars. These events are often led by professors or experts, providing valuable insights and practical skills. For instance, a workshop on research methodology can help students improve their research abilities.

Furthermore, students should actively engage with their professors. Professors are not only sources of knowledge but also can offer personalized guidance. By having regular office-hour meetings, students can clarify their doubts and get advice on their academic plans.

In conclusion, by making use of the library, participating in workshops, and interacting with professors, students can effectively utilize on-campus resources for their academic growth.
